observed_logical_capacity.limitations: Logical observed Rust capacities only. Includes graph warmup in process-lifetime peaks; internal dictionary decode buffers, allocator overhead, RDKit allocations and stack are unobserved. Do not sum independent peaks or add these to RSS/PSS.

heldout_extension.scope: Two absent small molecules, four metadata filters each, one cohort of four simultaneous requests/case/variant. Bounded correctness/concurrency probes, not a production distribution or independent cohort replication. CPU/request is cohort aggregate divided by four, not individual request attribution.

instrumented_source.acceptance: Nine scoring tests, full36-case native REST pilot,200 repeated similarity requests and32 held-out C4 requests pass; all services normal exit0, retained observed buffers zero after cohorts and eight immutable split hashes verified.

mechanism: Global width/cardinality validation retained; bounded batched dictionary validation plus candidate-only batched scoring. Speedup cannot be attributed solely to fewer distances; batched dictionary access is a separate contributor.
memory_and_overhead_limits: Shared RSS/PSS are sampled, nonadditive process values. Owned logical buffer capacities are limited instrumentation, not full allocation profiling. Per-case RSS windows differ from full mixed-workload process peaks. Instrumentation ratios include sequential run-to-run variation and are not corrections for individual stages.
publication_scope: Combined batched decoding and candidate-first exact scoring on100k, result/predicate caches disabled; local source only. Includes separate bounded held-out C4 probes.
